model.name: diagram.rerouteEdges
model.description: R33.6.3 (architect design 594b22361): reroute connector lines LIVE when a box moves. In wireBoxDrag pointermove, after setting the moved box transform, call the NEW rerouteEdges(uuid,rect): for each .dm-edge with data-rel-from/to == the moved modelelement uuid, recompute BOTH endpoints from the two boxes' CURRENT rects via the EXPORTED borderPoint geometry (the SAME clip-to-border fn buildEdges uses statically) -> set x1/y1/x2/y2. Correct-by-construction: single geometry fn => release->re-render shows NO drift. INV-R1 (no-drift)/R2 (only connected edges)/R3 (no-fork; buildEdges stays authoritative on full render). Singular chain = the NEW decl rerouteEdges; borderPoint EXPORT is a visibility change (enabler, not a traced method), buildEdges unchanged. Reuse borderPoint + R32.6 edge data-*, NO fork.
